intro: Convert grams to ounces quickly for kitchen recipes, coffee bags, postal parcels, and dry ingredient scaling. Because 1 avoirdupois ounce equals 28.349523 grams, dividing grams by 28.349523 (or multiplying by 0.03527396) gives the exact weight in ounces. Note that dry weight ounces (oz) measure mass, whereas fluid ounces (fl oz) measure liquid volume—they only match numerically for pure water. Browse the complete grams-to-ounces reference chart below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Avoirdupois Ounces (oz) vs. Troy Ounces (oz t) vs. Fluid Ounces (fl oz)
items: Standard grocery and postal scales use the Avoirdupois ounce (1 oz = 28.349523125 g). Gold, silver, and platinum bullion use the Troy ounce (1 oz t = 31.1034768 g), which is 9.7% heavier.
Never confuse dry weight ounces (oz) with liquid volume fluid ounces (fl oz); they only match numerically for pure water at standard density.

faqs.question: What is the formula to convert grams to oz?
faqs.answer: To convert grams to ounces, use the formula oz = g ÷ 28.349523 (or oz = g × 0.03527396). For example, 500 g ÷ 28.349523 equals 17.63698 oz.

faqs.question: How many grams are in a half ounce?
faqs.answer: There are approximately 14.1748 grams (14.17476 g exact) in a half avoirdupois ounce (0.5 oz), often rounded to 14.2 g.

faqs.question: How many grams are in a quarter ounce?
faqs.answer: There are approximately 7.0874 grams (7.08738 g exact) in a quarter avoirdupois ounce (0.25 oz), often rounded to 7.1 g.

faqs.question: Are grams or ounces bigger?
faqs.answer: An ounce is much bigger than a gram: 1 avoirdupois ounce equals 28.349523 grams, whereas 1 gram is only 0.03527 ounces.

faqs.question: What is the difference between a standard ounce and a troy ounce?
faqs.answer: A standard (avoirdupois) ounce used for food and postal parcels weighs 28.3495 grams, whereas a Troy ounce (oz t) used for precious metals weighs 31.1035 grams.
